invariants.rule: Since 11.10.2026: GitHub main = canon (master + 7 docs, status, site); Drive / Notion / Library / Project files = read-only backups; Topview = telemetry; Notion = story.
One master: video-prompts.md in GitHub main; no v2/final/copy.
Before any master write: fresh git pull of main; minimal commit → SYNC-TRIGGER → validator health=ok → Pages → verification; rejected push = another writer, redo from scratch.
Instruction edits: fresh pull → minimal commit → scripts/cert_github.py → push → verify; never replay a stale write.
Scene IDs stable; retired IDs never reused; rerender keeps the same Scene ID.
Topview technical success ≠ editorial approval; never auto approve/rerun/delete/close.
Slot capacity 6; one active task = one slot; a terminal task frees its slot at once; canonical slow is cleared only by an explicit owner button (11.10.2026), never by a technical terminal.

One writer, decided by monitor-role.json + scripts/monitor_role.py: since 13.10.2026 the GitHub robot (topview-robot.yml → robot_telemetry.py, every 10 min via Supabase pg_cron) is primary, ChatGPT is standby and takes over only after 180 min without a verified healthy robot cycle; the Claude monitor is off; kill switch ROBOT_TELEMETRY=shadow. Old ChatGPT HH:00 monitor and archived Recovery/slot-watcher stay off.
Never fake checked_at/queue/ETA; partial phases keep last confirmed timestamps.
Owner decides only creative/editorial choices, ambiguous task↔Scene mapping, approval, rerender, deletion/closing; deterministic work is done by the agent; never ask for info already in sources.
Every copyable prompt is self-contained: identity lock, reference roles/priority, camera/space, timeline, native audio, negatives, FRAME FILL.
Material workflow/site/authority/recovery change → relevant canonical docs + SAME handoff → cert_github.py certificate → push to main → Notion pointer → backup copies (best-effort).
Agents may launch only owner-authorized queue items via the website in Unlimited mode at zero credits. Paid Topview launches are performed only by the owner.
Library is best-effort, never a completion gate.
Never say «готово» before the relevant read-back/verification passed.

live_checks_required: Fresh main and canon lock before writing
Open owner_decisions and agent inbox; do not infer approval from this packet
Current capabilities; for a video submit use all-project slot scan, input/QC, Unlimited0 and CAS claim

queue_recovery.rule: Existing task ID: inspect, never resubmit. Claim/unknown without receipt: reconcile first; no retry.
